title: 〜ずくめ
simpleExplanation: Nずくめ means something is made up entirely of N or is full of N from beginning to end: いいことずくめ "nothing but good things", 黒ずくめ "all in black". It works with a small set of nouns and is usually positive or neutral, unlike だらけ and まみれ.
whenUsed: Both registers: conversation, magazines, blogs, news headlines. Common with colours (黒ずくめ), good things (いいことずくめ), feasts (ごちそうずくめ) and rules (規則ずくめ).
formation: Noun + ずくめ (+ の + Noun / + だ / + で)
Set nouns: いいこと, 黒, 白, ごちそう, 規則, 結構, 幸せ, 異例

diagram.title: ずくめ / だらけ / まみれ

rows.label: 〜ずくめ
cells: everything is N, through and through
いいことずくめの一年

rows.label: 〜まみれ
cells: surface coated with a dirty substance

examples.ja: 今年はいいことずくめの一年だった。
examples.reading: ことしはいいことずくめのいちねんだった。
examples.en: This year was full of good things.
examples.note: The most common positive use: a year full of good things.

examples.ja: 黒ずくめの服装の男が店に入ってきた。
examples.reading: くろずくめのふくそうのおとこがみせにはいってきた。
examples.en: A man dressed entirely in black came into the shop.
examples.note: Colour + ずくめ: an outfit entirely in black.

examples.ja: 彼女の毎日は規則ずくめで息が詰まりそうだ。
examples.reading: かのじょのまいにちはきそくずくめでいきがつまりそうだ。
examples.en: Her days are so full of rules that she feels suffocated.
examples.note: 規則ずくめ: a negative feeling created by the context, not by ずくめ itself.

examples.ja: 結婚に昇進にと、今年は彼にとって幸せずくめの一年だった。
examples.reading: けっこんにしょうしんにと、ことしはかれにとってしあわせずくめのいちねんだった。
examples.en: With his marriage and promotion, this was a year full of happiness for him.
examples.note: 幸せずくめ: a set collocation.

examples.ja: 今回の人事は異例ずくめだった。
examples.reading: こんかいのじんじはいれいずくめだった。
examples.en: This round of personnel changes was unprecedented in every respect.
examples.note: News style: 異例ずくめ (nothing but exceptions).

similarGrammar.difference: Many undesirable things (ゴミだらけ). ずくめ is not negative in itself.
Coated in a dirty substance (血まみれ, 汗まみれ). Physical only.
"Involving the whole of N" (家族ぐるみ, 町ぐるみ): totality of participants, not of contents.

commonMistakes.why: A dirty coating takes まみれ.
Many mistakes take だらけ, since the evaluation is negative.

commonMistakes.right: 楽しいことずくめの旅行
commonMistakes.why: ずくめ attaches to nouns; turn the adjective into a noun phrase (楽しいこと).

usageNotes: The noun set is limited; do not invent new combinations freely.
Before a noun use の: いいことずくめの一年.
Sentence end: 〜ずくめだ / ずくめで(大変だ).
jlptTips: If the noun is 黒 / いいこと / ごちそう / 規則 / 異例, the answer is ずくめ; if the noun is dirt (泥, 血) it is まみれ; if it is faults (間違い, 傷) it is だらけ.
Check the evaluation of the sentence: a happy or neutral tone rules out だらけ / まみれ.
In vocabulary-style grammar questions, ずくめ may be tested with 黒ずくめの男 in reading passages as well.
